title: OpenBrick3D validator report
description: What the validator found on a built part (openbrick_print::Report, written by serde_json): the contract of `openbrick validate --json` (docs/plan/05 sections 5 and 9). Findings are sorted blockers first, then by rule id, feature and message. A part may be exported when no finding is a blocker; warnings never block. cargo xtask data checks the expected reports of the validator fixtures (crates/openbrick-print/tests/fixtures/validator/) against this schema.

finding.description: One validator message (openbrick_print::Finding). Every message carries the rule id, the measured value, the threshold and a fix hint (CLAUDE.md).

rule.description: Rule id from the table in docs/plan/05 section 5. openbrick_print::IMPLEMENTED_RULES lists the rules checked today and PLANNED_RULES the rest; cargo xtask data checks that this enum is exactly both.

severity.description: blocker: export is disabled until it is fixed; warning: shown, never blocks.

message.description: What was measured, with the value, its unit and the threshold.

value.description: The measured value, in the frame the rule compares: millimetres, with lengths in the bed plane as drawn plus fit offsets (the mesh length divided by the fit profile's xyScale); except MESH.VOLUME (deviation in percent; the volume in mm3 when it is not positive), FEATURE.MIN on the removed area (percent of the artwork area) and MESH.MANIFOLD on an empty mesh (component count). Null when the rule measures no number (FIT.PROCESS, FIT.MISSING, a non-manifold mesh, a volume that is not a finite number).

threshold.description: The threshold the value broke, in the unit of value (0 for a volume that is not positive); null with a null value.

fix.description: What to change, kindly worded (for example: raise reliefHeight to 0.4 mm).

feature.description: Id of the part feature concerned, when known; null or absent otherwise.
